movelist.name: Acid
movelist.effect: Acid lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 18+.

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Constrict
movelist.effect: Constrict lowers the target’s Speed 1 Combat Stage. Constrict may be used as a Swift Action against targets the user is Grappling, and automatically hits when performed this way.

movelist.name: Toxic Spikes
movelist.effect: Set 8 square meters of Toxic Spikes, all 8 meters must be adjacent with at least one other space of Toxic Spikes next to each other. Toxic Spikes cause Terrain to become Slow Terrain, and a grounded foe that runs into the hazard becomes Poisoned, and Slowed until the end of their next turn. If there are 2 Layers of Toxic Spikes on the same space, it Deadly Poisons the foes instead. Poison-Type Pokémon may move over Toxic Spikes harmlessly, destroying the Hazards as they do so.

movelist.name: Supersonic
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Wrap
movelist.effect: The user gains a +1 Bonus to Accuracy Rolls made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers, and +2 to Skill Checks made to initiate Grapple Maneuvers or gain Dominance. Whenever the user gains Dominance in a Grapple, the target of the Grapple loses a Tick of Hit Points.

abilities.name: Clear Body
abilities.effect: The user’s Combat Stages may not be lowered by the effect of foes’ Feautres, Abilities, or Moves. Status Affictions may still alter their Combat Stages. Defensive.

abilities.name: Poison Touch
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Moves which deal damage Poison Legal Targets on 19+. If a move already has a chance of Poisoning foes, Poison Touch increases the effect range by +2.
